_doc: Capture the Flag (2v2 to 4v4): take the other side's flag from its base and bring it to yours while your own is home. Touching a flag (within pickup_radius plus your body) takes it, or sends your own dropped flag home; a carrier is slowed (carry_slow) and drops it where it goes down; a dropped flag goes home by itself after return_seconds. First to captures_to_win, or more at time; a tie at time is sudden death. The first `defenders` CPU fighters of a side guard the base. Unlimited lives (respawns at your end like Team Deathmatch); KOs score nothing. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
